build_sauter_model_config: build a SauterModelConfig instance to configure the Sauter conductivity model
build_sauter_model: build a SauterModel instance from SauterModelConfig to calculate neoclassical conductivity
calculate_conductivity: calculate neoclassical conductivity using the Sauter model with geometry and core profiles
build_runtime_params: build RuntimeParams for the Sauter conductivity model configuration
calculate_conductivity_internal: calculate conductivity internally using Z_eff, electron density, temperature, safety factor, and geometry
